FN-7RSS22V-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 314
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Representative Curtis Travis
Security
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 03/18/2024
House Bill 314 as introduced would expand the eligibility for the current firefighter distinctive
license plate to include the issuance of one such plate to certain fire chaplains. This bill would
provide the additional annual $1 fee collected for firefighter distinctive license plates issued to
fire chaplains would be distributed to the Alabama Fellowship of Fire Chaplains.
This bill would also increase the administrative obligations of the Department of Revenue to
carry out the provisions of this bill.
